# 會 + Verb · *wui5 + Verb*

**Meaning:** will; would; likely to · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Wants, needs and ability

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fwui5-will).

會 before a verb talks about the future or what is likely: it will rain, I'll call you. 唔會 means 'won't' or 'is unlikely to'.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **聽日會落雨。** |
| Jyutping | ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5. |
| Yale | tīng yaht wúih lohk yúh. |
| Bopomofo | ㄊㄧㄥ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄨㄨㄧ⁵ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄩ⁵. |
| English | It's going to rain tomorrow. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我聽日會打電話畀你。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5. |
| Yale | ngóh tīng yaht wúih dá dihn wá béi néih. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄊㄧㄥ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄨㄨㄧ⁵ ㄉㄚ² ㄉㄧㄣ⁶ ㄨㄚ² ㄅㄝㄧ² ㄋㄝㄧ⁵. |
| English | I'll phone you tomorrow. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢唔會嚟喇。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4 laa3. |
| Yale | kéuih m̀h wúih làih la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄨㄨㄧ⁵ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | He won't come now. |
